settings.heading: How long does it take to dry clothes?
settings.row_content: It depends on how thick they are. Everyday T-shirts usually dry in one cycle; thicker items such as blankets take two to three cycles.

settings.heading: How hot is the heated fan?
Is the UV function safe?
settings.row_content: It uses a 3-watt UV-C light, which is germicidal: it deactivates the DNA of bacteria, viruses and other microorganisms so they cannot multiply. It is strong enough to eliminate them but not harmful to people.

settings.heading: What does the ioniser do?
settings.row_content: Negative ions bind to odour molecules and help neutralise them, leaving the space smelling fresher.

settings.heading: What is the load capacity?
settings.row_content: It depends on the model. Current models carry 45 kg or 55 kg.

settings.heading: Which app do they use?
settings.row_content: Our app-controlled models run on the TUYA app. Remote controllers are also available.

settings.heading: How do you install on a false ceiling?
settings.row_content: The installer drills through the false ceiling and fixes the rack to the concrete ceiling above. We advise a site survey first, to check how deep the false ceiling is and whether there is piping or wiring.

settings.heading: Do you do site surveys?
settings.row_content: Yes, for every ceiling type. Our technician checks whether your ceiling is concrete or false, how high a false ceiling is, and where to install.

settings.heading: What if my ceiling is too high or too low?
settings.row_content: Lifting brackets can be customised to the length you need. For very high ceilings we also offer wall-mount installation and custom mount brackets.

settings.heading: What power supply does it need?
settings.row_content: A single light switch or a 3-pin power point.

settings.heading: How soon can it be installed?
settings.row_content: Contact our customer service team to arrange an installation date.

settings.heading: Do you relocate an existing rack?
settings.row_content: Yes, we offer relocation for Orlant smart drying racks, at an additional charge.

settings.heading: How does the warranty work?
settings.row_content: Five years on the motor, two years on parts and on-site servicing, and one year on the remote control. This covers manufacturing defects.

settings.heading: Still have a question?
settings.body: Message us on WhatsApp and a member of the Singapore team will answer.
